item.title: bo-5: atm-bd-lite skill: one-file hook, templates, cron tick, requirements

results.statement: Test code written in the phase must implement its repeated patterns through common helper methods instead of repeating them inline.
results.quote: test code is fine, but should be written efficiently w/ repeated patterns using common methods.
results.deterministic_check: no setup or assertion block of five or more identical lines appears in two test functions of the touched test files

results.statement: The dev and fix close hook must compare the PR base with the stack top (the branch of the layer below) and block the close when they differ, before it runs bd close and atm task close.
results.quote: 1) dev/fix 'atm task close' would check pr base vs. stack top (blocking close if not stacked properly) then do bd close, atm task close.
results.deterministic_check: a hook test with a mis-based PR exits non-zero and records no bd close or atm task close command

results.statement: The lite profile's orchestration must be runnable by a single agent.
results.quote: it will be a much simpler orchestration that could be run by a single agent or small team.
results.deterministic_check: the bo-7 live lite phase log shows one ATM identity performing dispatch, dev, QA and landing

results.statement: The lite task hook and the lite dispatch templates must take the profile from the phase file and refuse to run or render when it is not lite.
results.quote: the lite/orchestration flag is set in phase toml/json file.  You can’t run console for lite if agents are orchestrating.  This is critically important.  hooks/templates/cron/console must all align.
results.context: planning session 2026-10-31 (fenix), ANC-005 note; split of ANC-023 under Rand goal "complete phase-bo plan with qa + anc all passing and start Bo sprints"
results.deterministic_check: a test runs the hook runner and renders each lite template against a full phase file and asserts the ProfileMismatch exit

results.statement: Each atm-bd cron tick must take the profile from the phase file and refuse to run when it is not the tick's own profile.
results.quote: the lite/orchestration flag is set in phase toml/json file.  You can’t run console for lite if agents are orchestrating.  This is critically important.  hooks/templates/cron/console must all align.
results.context: planning session 2026-10-31 (fenix), ANC-005 note; split of ANC-023 under Rand goal "complete phase-bo plan with qa + anc all passing and start Bo sprints"
results.deterministic_check: a test runs the full tick on a lite phase file and the lite tick on a full phase file and asserts the ProfileMismatch exit for both

results.statement: The lite profile's task-close hook business logic must live in a single Python file, skills/atm-bd-lite/scripts/atm-bd-task-hook.py.
results.quote: The business logic is to be in a single small python file which is organized by transition type and enums w/ exhaustive checks (that will compile error if not handled)
results.deterministic_check: skills/atm-bd-lite/scripts contains one hook file and no other module imports or defines transition handling
results.explanation: Structural anchor: verified by its deterministic_check, not by Jev

results.statement: Transitions in the lite hook must be enum members with exhaustive checks, so that an unhandled member is a static error.
results.quote: The business logic is to be in a single small python file which is organized by transition type and enums w/ exhaustive checks (that will compile error if not handled)
results.deterministic_check: pyright strict with reportMatchNotExhaustive=error passes on the hook and a test removing one match arm makes it fail
results.explanation: Structural anchor: verified by its deterministic_check, not by Jev

results.statement: Lite-only scripts must live in skills/atm-bd-lite/scripts and lite-only templates in skills/atm-bd-lite/templates; full-only ones live relative to the atm-bd-orchestration skill.
results.quote: i would expect the atm-bd-lite only scripts to be in skills/atm-bd-lite/scripts/  and templates in atm-bd-lite/templates/ w/ corresponding atm-bd-orchestration scripts/stemplates located relative to the skill.
results.deterministic_check: every file under skills/atm-bd-lite/scripts and templates is imported or rendered only by lite; core/ holds nothing lite-only
results.explanation: Structural anchor: verified by its deterministic_check, not by Jev

results.statement: The atm-bd-lite skill must have its own task-hook Python file, separate from the atm-bd-orchestration skill's atm-task-close.py.
results.quote: the atm-bd-lite would have a completely different atm-task-hook python file.
results.deterministic_check: skills/atm-bd-lite/scripts contains a hook file and the full profile's atm-task-close.py has no lite branch
results.explanation: Structural anchor: verified by its deterministic_check, not by Jev

results.statement: The lite task-hook file must be organized by transition type: one handler section per transition (dev close, fix close, QA close).
results.quote: The business logic is to be in a single small python file which is organized by transition type and enums w/ exhaustive checks (that will compile error if not handled)
results.deterministic_check: the hook file has one handler per Transition member and no handler serves two transitions
results.explanation: Structural anchor: verified by its deterministic_check, not by Jev
